name: Bootleg Mixtape
summary: The Bootleg Mixtape aesthetic is a graphic design style that dominated Southern Hip-Hop/Trap mixtape covers from the mid-2000s to the late-2010s.
description: The Bootleg Mixtape aesthetic is a graphic design style that dominated Southern Hip-Hop/Trap mixtape covers from the mid-2000s to the late-2010s. Pioneered by designers such as KidEight, Miami Kaos, Skrilla Design, and TanstA, the style is characterized by its use of cartoonish, hyper-real and thematic maximalism, featuring layered photo collages similar to its predecessor aesthetic, Pen & Pixel .
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Wealth display, maximalism, surrealism, "hood rich" aspirations
